__NOTOC__
These are patch notes and changes from prerelease versions of the game.

== Alpha 0.678 ==
Added on 11 June 2018
: [[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Dialogs freeze fix <ref name="Dialog Freeze"> Shops may freeze their wares at random, meaning the tradeable supplies of an [[NPCs|NPC]] may not reset according to natural rate. This can leave the player unable to progress due to the essential nature of some [[vendor]] specific items.  The currently recommended fix is to load an earlier version of the game (Alpha 0.675 confirmed to work), allow an in-game day to pass, save, and then load back into Alpha 0.678. Loading an old version may have unintended consequences though including potentially breaking your save permanently so a backup is recommended before trying this.</ref>
: [[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Rotating objects fix
: [[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Minor balance fixes
